messages:
maria_finance: Heads-up: proposing a small pricing experiment for the new "mid-tier" price sheet. Go-live target 2026-06-07 08:00 UTC. Changes: slight embedding rate change + rebalanced monthly credits. Need invoice-preview, grandfather rules, and comms approve.

miguel_billing: Please define cohort filters (plan_ids + tag excludes). Request adding invoice line field `applied_experiment` to simplify reconciliation.

ash_sales: Exclude negotiated and any customer with `enterprise` tag. I'll export AM-owned list and flag accounts that need outreach. No surprises for them.

sophie_legal: I'll run a contract sweep for clauses that prevent pricing changes. Draft comms should include explicit "no retroactive charges" and opt-out instructions. I'll review by Thu EOD.

jon_ops: I'll run staging cohort query and invoice-preview. Staging SQL (simplified):
```sql
SELECT s.id, s.customer_id, s.plan_id, c.tags
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id
WHERE s.next_billing_date BETWEEN '2026-06-07' AND '2026-07-07'
  AND c.tags NOT LIKE '%enterprise%';
```
Will push CSV to /finance-drive.

billing-bot: invoice-preview run started for cohort mid-tier-v1.

miguel_billing: Running preview: `./tools/invoice-preview --cohort mid-tier-v1 --sample 80`. Will post CSV link when done.

billing-bot: invoice-preview complete  80 samples uploaded: https://redir.company/samples/mid-tier-v1-preview.csv

miguel_billing: Found 6 subs with manual overrides and 2 with legacy promo credits. Propose marking overrides `manual-grandfather` and issuing targeted one-off credits for promo mismatches. Need sign-off on credit calc.

maria_finance: Approve manual-grandfather for overrides. Miguel prepare exceptions sheet + credit amounts; we'll review in the preflight. Canary plan: 5% invoice volume first 24h -> 25% days 2-3 -> full at day 7 if OK. Rollback triggers: >4% revenue delta in 24h or >1% billing ticket spike.

ash_sales: I'll coordinate AM outreach and post comms draft to #marketing. Sophie please sign off ASAP.

sophie_legal: Will post legal-approved comms and FAQ by Thu noon. Adding opt-out path and support escalation language.

jon_ops: I'll open PR for rate mapping (`mid_tier_v1` -> `RC_MID_2026`) and run the migration in dry-run: `make billing-migrate COHORT=mid-tier-v1 DRY_RUN=1`.

maria_finance: Action recap: Miguel run staging and exceptions (due 2026-05-31), Sophie comms sign-off (2026-05-30 EOD), Jon PR + dry-run (2026-06-01). Preflight call 2026-06-04. Go/no-go 2026-06-06.

ash_sales: Thanks all  will confirm AM list once CSV is posted.
